detailed_description: The Octal Converter converts one pasted number at a time between octal, decimal, binary, and hexadecimal using selectable conversion modes. Choose a mode such as octal to decimal, decimal to octal, octal to binary, binary to octal, octal to hex, or hex to octal, enter the value, and click Convert. The tool validates basic input characters for the selected mode, displays a single converted result, and lets you copy the output.
usage_steps: Select one conversion mode from the mode dropdown.
Enter the value in the input textarea, using digits valid for that mode.
Click Convert to generate the converted value.
Use Load Sample for a quick example or copy the output after conversion.
usage_examples: Convert an octal permission value such as 755 to its decimal equivalent.
Turn a decimal number into octal while checking a simple programming example.
Convert binary bits to octal for a quick base-notation exercise.
Translate an octal value to hexadecimal when comparing number representations.
